topic: Saad receives a voice note in his own voice that he never recorded.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Voice He Never Recorded

shots.narration: Saad's phone played his voice: 'Don't open the waiting room.'
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated film look; old Pakistani haveli courtyard at midnight, brass lantern between Bashir and Saad, phone screen blank.
shots.action: Saad lifts his glowing phone toward his ear.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, warm lantern glow, deep archway shadows.

shots.narration: Bashir began: 'Last night, you followed that voice.'
shots.scene: Haveli courtyard beside the brass lantern; Bashir wears his white cap and brown woollen shawl, grey beard warmly lit.
shots.action: Bashir points toward the distant railway tracks.
shots.mood: Still night air, low fog, uneasy storytelling intimacy.

shots.narration: [whispers] The message led Saad to an empty railway station.
shots.scene: Story flashback; deserted Pakistani village railway platform, unmarked walls, shuttered ticket windows, no signs or lettering.
shots.action: Saad walks onto the platform with his small torch.
shots.mood: Blue moonlight, drifting fog, enormous empty space.

shots.narration: Another message arrived, still speaking in his own voice.
shots.scene: Empty platform beside a weathered wooden bench; Saad wears his dark green hoodie and jeans.
shots.action: Saad draws his newly glowing phone from his pocket.
shots.mood: Pale screen glow, motionless darkness, isolated anticipation.

shots.scene: Outside a closed wooden waiting-room door, phone screen blank, cracked plaster and dusty floor.
shots.action: Saad places his lit torch beside the door.
shots.mood: Sharp floor-level light, towering shadows, reluctant obedience.

shots.narration: [sighs] Saad obeyed, but kept his phone.
shots.scene: Waiting-room threshold with the torch shining upward from the platform floor.
shots.action: Saad pushes the wooden door inward.
shots.mood: Thin opening into blackness, suspended dust, tense stillness.

shots.narration: Inside, there was only a bench and his shadow.
shots.scene: Bare waiting room with one wooden bench; the outside torch projects Saad's shadow onto the opposite wall.
shots.mood: Long distorted silhouette, peeling plaster, cold empty corners.

shots.narration: He lowered his phone, but the shadow didn't.
shots.scene: Saad beside the bench, his wall shadow clearly visible with one arm still bent beside its head.
shots.action: Saad lowers his phone to his thigh.
shots.mood: Impossible mismatch, hard torchlight, silent dread.

shots.narration: [whispers] Then his own voice came from the wall.
shots.scene: Waiting room wall bearing Saad's shadow with a phone-shaped silhouette beside its ear.
shots.action: Saad turns his face toward the shadow.
shots.mood: Rigid silhouette, widening eyes, darkness pressing around the light.

shots.narration: 'I told you not to open it.'
shots.scene: Saad stands before the shadow, his real phone hanging at his side, the doorway behind him.
shots.mood: Narrow escape space, looming wall shadow, breathless anticipation.

shots.narration: The shadow turned toward him, though Saad stood completely still.
shots.scene: Waiting room; Saad frozen in profile while his shadow holds its phone against the wall.
shots.action: Saad's shadow rotates its head to face him.
shots.mood: Unnaturally stretched head, stark black silhouette, peak supernatural terror.

shots.narration: [whispers] 'Tomorrow,' Bashir said, 'I'll explain why mine has a phone.'
shots.scene: Back in the haveli courtyard; Bashir's empty hands rest beside the lantern, his shadow falls across the wall.
shots.action: Bashir's shadow lifts a phone-shaped silhouette to its ear.
shots.mood: Warm lantern light betrayed by an impossible shadow, lingering midnight dread.

episode.endHook: Tomorrow, Bashir explains why his shadow has a phone too.
episode.description: By Bashir Chacha's lantern, Saad hears a story about a voice note he never recorded—and the empty railway station it led him to. A fictional Midnight Watch mystery where even shadows have secrets.
